scenes.description: A single short Arabic prompt line sits low-left in the safe area, paper-white on near-black. Words stamp in one at a time, no blur, each landing on a single step. A block cursor arrives at the end of the line and then simply holds, blinking on a slow 2-step cycle. Nothing else enters. The frame's job is to feel anticlimactic.
scenes.framing: Body-scale type on a near-empty field; line sits at roughly 55% frame height, left-aligned in RTL terms (reading edge right)
scenes.movement: Word-by-word stamp-in, then absolute stillness for the final 1.2s hold
scenes.overlay_notes: label «أنت» as a small mono eyebrow, top-right of the safe area
scenes.shot_intent: The typed line itself — a live prompt field at body scale, nothing else in frame
scenes.information_role: That what you did was tiny — one line, then waiting

scenes.description: The prompt line shrinks and docks to the top. A flat arrow draws rightward into an empty rectangle labelled «أمر واحد». The box stays conspicuously empty for a beat, then a single accent-yellow stroke strikes through it on the word «لم يفعل». The arrow does not retract — it is left pointing at a struck-out box.
scenes.framing: Centred single object, wide negative field above and below; box occupies about a third of the frame width
scenes.movement: Arrow line-draws left-to-right in RTL reading order, then one strike stroke; no easing on the strike
scenes.overlay_notes: label «ما حدث فعلاً» mono eyebrow top-right | docked prompt line from sc1 persists as a small header, 40% opacity
scenes.shot_intent: The absent command — an empty box, the only object in the video that stays empty
scenes.information_role: That their mental model is wrong before being told what is right

required_assets.description: Hand-authored HyperFrames clip for sc2 — authored HTML/CSS/GSAP, no registry block consumed as a scene

scenes.description: Three nodes snap into an equilateral triangle, one per narrated phase, each arriving hard with no overshoot. Connecting arcs draw between them in reading order. Then the completed ring rotates exactly one full turn in silence, stepped at roughly 12fps so the rotation reads as a series of positions rather than a glide. It stops where it started and holds.
scenes.framing: Centred, ring fills about 60% of the safe-area width, generous air around it; the three labels sit outside the ring so Arabic never rotates
scenes.movement: Node-by-node snap-in on the narration beats, then one stepped 360° rotation unspoken
scenes.overlay_notes: three phase labels «يقرأ» «ينفّذ» «يتحقّق» pinned outside the ring, upright, never rotating with it | label «يقرأ · ينفّذ · يتحقّق» suppressed here — the ring labels already carry it
scenes.shot_intent: THE RING — signature device, first of only two appearances
scenes.information_role: The shape of the whole video in one object

required_assets.description: Hand-authored HyperFrames clip for sc3 — authored HTML/CSS/GSAP, no registry block consumed as a scene

scenes.description: A file tree fills the vertical frame top to bottom, far denser than it needs to be, near-black on near-black so it reads as texture. A thin search line sweeps down through it. Four files ignite in accent yellow as the line passes them; everything else stays dark. The sweep exits the bottom of the frame and the four lit files hold alone in the darkness.
scenes.framing: Full-bleed vertical texture, edge to edge — the only full-bleed scene in the piece; lit files cluster in the middle third
scenes.movement: Single downward sweep at constant speed, four discrete ignitions; no camera move, the sweep is the motion
scenes.overlay_notes: label «grep» in the Latin mono face, dir=ltr, top-right | no phase label — the ring is deliberately absent from this scene
scenes.shot_intent: A file tree — dense, data-driven, the only scene with hundreds of elements
scenes.information_role: That it searches rather than remembers — and that most of the project is never touched

required_assets.description: Hand-authored HyperFrames clip for sc4 — authored HTML/CSS/GSAP, no registry block consumed as a scene

scenes.description: A diff block assembles line by line in the centre of the frame. Added lines arrive in accent yellow with a left gutter mark; removed lines arrive already struck through in dim grey. Each line lands on a single step with no easing and no fade — stamped, like movable type. The block finishes slightly off-centre and is not corrected.
scenes.framing: Centred block at about 70% safe-area width, code set dir=ltr in the mono face; air above and below, nothing in the corners
scenes.movement: Sequential line stamp-in, roughly four lines per second, constant rhythm — deliberately mechanical
scenes.overlay_notes: label «يعدّل، لا يقترح» mono eyebrow top-right
scenes.shot_intent: A diff — code lines as objects, the only scene containing Latin code
scenes.information_role: That it writes into the real files rather than handing over a suggestion

scenes.description: One wide horizontal bar sits centred in the frame. It fills red, clears, fills red again, clears, then fills green — each fill landing on one of the four narrated verbs, the gap between fills shortening each time. On green it stops dead and holds longer than feels comfortable. A small pass counter ticks 1, 2, 3 beside it.
scenes.framing: Single horizontal element at the vertical centre, spanning about 80% of safe-area width; counter sits beside its trailing edge
scenes.movement: Three accelerating fills, hard stop on green, then a 2.2s hold with zero motion in frame
scenes.overlay_notes: label «أحمر ← أخضر» mono eyebrow top-right | pass counter as a small mono numeral, not a label
scenes.shot_intent: A test bar — a single horizontal element, the only scene whose subject changes colour
scenes.information_role: That verification is something it does to itself, repeatedly, without being asked

required_assets.description: Hand-authored HyperFrames clip for sc6 — authored HTML/CSS/GSAP, no registry block consumed as a scene

scenes.description: The ring returns at a larger scale than in sc3. It holds still, then a hard division runs through it: the «يقرأ/ينفّذ» arc stays paper-white outline, the «يتحقّق» arc fills solid accent yellow. Nothing moves after the fill. This is a single held still frame for nearly two seconds — the most screenshot-able frame in the video and the only scene with no motion in its second half.
scenes.framing: Centred, ring now at about 75% safe-area width — the largest object in the piece; the editorial line sits beneath it at display scale
scenes.movement: One fill transition, then total stillness; the absence of motion is the emphasis
scenes.overlay_notes: label «نصف العمل» promoted from eyebrow to display scale beneath the ring — the only scene where the label outranks the eyebrow
scenes.shot_intent: THE RING, SPLIT — signature device, second and final appearance; the hero moment
scenes.information_role: The one opinion the video holds: the unglamorous half is the work

scenes.description: No ring. Tally marks stamp into the frame in a grid, each one a completed pass of the loop, arriving faster and faster until the grid is dense. The acceleration is the content. On the last mark everything stops and a single row highlights in accent yellow to mark the pass that finished the task.
scenes.framing: Grid building from the top of the safe area downward, filling about two-thirds of the frame height; final highlighted row sits at the grid's base
scenes.movement: Accelerating stamp-in from roughly 2/sec to 8/sec, then a hard stop and one highlight
scenes.overlay_notes: label «حتى تنتهي المهمة» mono eyebrow top-right
scenes.shot_intent: A tally of completed passes — accumulation, the only scene that counts
scenes.information_role: That the loop runs as many times as it needs to, and then stops

scenes.description: After the whip, two objects sit side by side: an interrupt key, and a stack of file snapshots layered behind one another. The key presses down once and releases. The snapshot stack shifts to reveal that each layer predates the edit above it. Both objects are drawn, not photographic. A small human mark sits between them at the scale of a typographic character.
scenes.framing: Two objects on a horizontal axis at mid-frame, roughly symmetrical, with the human mark small between them; this is the only two-subject composition in the piece
scenes.movement: One press-and-release on the key, one lateral shift on the snapshot stack, offset by 0.4s so they do not move together
scenes.overlay_notes: label «مقاطعة · تعديلات محفوظة» mono eyebrow top-right, set as two clauses matching the two objects
scenes.shot_intent: Two controls — the viewer's own handles, the only scene depicting the user's agency
scenes.information_role: That they hold the controls — the fear of irreversible damage is answered

scenes.description: Full-bleed type for the first time since the open, but where sc1 was body-scale and low in the frame, this is display-scale and centred, set in the heavy Arabic display weight. Two clauses reveal word by word with a beat between them. The ring appears only as a small mark the size of a letterform beside the final clause — reduced from hero to punctuation. The watermark fades in during the closing hold.
scenes.framing: Centred display-scale type filling the middle third; the reduced ring mark sits at the baseline of the final clause
scenes.movement: Word-by-word reveal in two clauses, then a 2.5s hold with only the watermark fading
scenes.overlay_notes: label «حلقة، لا أمر» suppressed — the narration line IS the on-screen line in this scene only, by design | watermark a7med.breiki at 40% opacity, white on dark, fading in over the final 1.5s

scene_distinctness_review.any_two_scenes_share_primary_subject: No two scenes share a primary visual subject. The closest pair is sc1 and sc10, which are both typographic — this is a deliberate bookend, and they are separated by scale (body vs display), position (low-left vs centred), weight (regular vs heavy) and function (a prompt being typed vs an assertion being made). Declared rather than hidden.
signature_device_appearances: sc7 — hero moment, split and filled
scene_distinctness_review.signature_device_scarcity_check: Two appearances, which is the maximum the skill allows. sc10 contains a reduced ring mark at letterform scale, counted as punctuation rather than a third appearance of the device.
scene_distinctness_review.hero_component_spine_check: PASSED ONLY AFTER A RE-PLAN. The first draft of this plan put the ring in sc3, sc4, sc5, sc6, sc7 and sc8 — rotating it to indicate the current phase. That is exactly the hero-component spine the skill forbids: one striking visual reused every scene with different text under it. Re-planned so sc4, sc5, sc6 and sc8 each carry their own distinct subject (file tree / diff / test bar / tally grid) and the phase is carried by a small eyebrow label instead, which is an overlay rather than a subject.
scene_distinctness_review.removal_test: For each of sc4, sc5, sc6, sc8, sc9: removing the signature device leaves the scene fully intact, which is why it is absent from them. For sc3 and sc7 the device IS the scene.

animatic_rules: One visual idea per scene; if two scenes could collapse without losing meaning, they should
Entrances land on a single step — no multi-frame eases on arrival
Nothing moves during a hold. The hold is an absence of motion, not slow motion
Arabic text never rotates, never scales during a reveal, and never splits below word level

transition_rules.policy: Hard cut is the default and carries 8 of the 9 transitions. One whip_pan marks the single act break (machine → viewer, sc8→sc9). One fade marks the close (sc9→sc10). No transition idea is introduced more than once.
transition_rules.rejected: No slides, no dissolves, no zoom transitions, no shader/distortion transitions from the HF registry — the Vox read depends on cuts, and a registry transition block consumed as a scene element would violate atelier mode.

hold_rules.policy: Every scene ends on a hold long enough for its visual to finish. Narration never runs over a reveal — the pause policy in script.voice_performance is the contract.

tool_path_map.every_scene: Hand-authored HyperFrames clip in a single project index.html (or sub-composition mounts once the clip count passes 4), rendered via video_compose with render_runtime=hyperframes, composition_mode=atelier, workspace_path=projects/vox-claude-webapp-ar/hf/
tool_path_map.narration: elevenlabs via the MCP connector — BLOCKED, connector returns a permissions error
tool_path_map.no_image_or_video_generation: Every visual element is authored. Nothing is generated or sourced.

reusable_motifs: Accent-yellow assertion marker — appears only on the thing being claimed, never decoratively
Mono eyebrow label, top-right of the safe area, in every scene except sc3 and sc10 where it is deliberately suppressed
Single-step arrival with no motion blur, applied to every entering element
Strike-through stroke, used twice only: sc2 (the empty box) and sc5 (removed diff lines)

captions_vs_onscreen_text.decision: On-screen text adds meaning the narration does not carry — it is never a transcript of it. Eyebrow labels name mechanisms (grep, أحمر ← أخضر) that the voice does not say.
captions_vs_onscreen_text.consequence: Burned captions are therefore OFF by default to avoid the doubled-phrase amateurism the skill warns about. subtitle_gen still produces a separate sidecar caption file for accessibility and sound-off viewing, delivered alongside the video rather than burned into it.
captions_vs_onscreen_text.single_exception: sc10 is the one scene where the on-screen line and the narration line are identical. Declared deliberately — it is the closing assertion, and the repetition is the point.

arabic_text_rules: Word-level reveals only — split on spaces, never per glyph
No letterSpacing on Arabic at any weight
Arabic containers dir=rtl; Latin tokens (grep, Claude Code) dir=ltr in the Latin mono face
Labels pinned outside the ring in sc3 and sc7 so no Arabic glyph ever rotates
Reveal direction verified under RTL before authoring — LTR-built typewriter patterns run backwards

safe_area.insets: ~270px top, ~670px bottom, ~65px sides (the widely-cited Meta 14/35/6 scheme; sources disagree and none cites a primary Meta page, so treat as approximate and verify on device)
safe_area.consequence: Every label, chart and line lives inside roughly the central 950x980 region. sc4 is the only full-bleed scene, and its lit files are kept inside the safe band even though its texture bleeds.

open_blockers: ElevenLabs connector returns a permissions error — narration cannot be produced, so scene timings stay provisional
faster-whisper not installed — needed to calibrate these boundaries against real narration audio
Timings here are structural. Every start/end will move once the voice track exists.
